description: Polyphonic oscillator with sine, triangle, square and saw outputs running at once plus a configurable mix, each wave having its own shape, phase, offset and level

params.text: Picks the overall mode: audio, low frequency, 0Hz carrier for linear FM, or a triggered, retriggered or gated one shot that fires from the SYNC input
Sets the oversampling applied to the audio output, off or x2 through x32; audio and 0Hz carrier modes start at x4 and the LFO modes start off
Picks what the shape knob does to the square wave: pulse width limited to 3% to 97%, full pulse width from 0% to 100%, or a morph from triangle through square to saw
Picks how the waves are combined: sum or average, each of them plain, saturated or folded; the average options hold the output near 10V peak to peak
Switches on a high pass filter that removes DC offset from all outputs, off by default
Sets the base frequency, 16.352Hz to 4186Hz in audio mode with C4 at the centre and 0.125Hz to 32Hz in low frequency mode; in 0Hz carrier mode it is a bias of -0.08Hz to 0.08Hz
Shifts the frequency by as much as four octaves either way; in 0Hz carrier mode it sets the range of the linear FM depth instead
Momentarily forces every output monophonic so the channel count is recomputed, which restores the right polyphony in a patch with feedback
Sets the depth of exponential frequency modulation, -100% to 100%, and has no effect in 0Hz carrier mode
Sets the depth of through-zero linear frequency modulation, -100% to 100%
Sets how much shaping is applied to that wave, -100% to 100%, with the type of shaping set by that wave's SHAPE MODE button
Sets the pulse width of the square wave, 0% to 100% with 50% at the centre, within the range chosen by the square SHAPE MODE button
Sets how much saturation or folding is applied to the mix, 0% to 100%
Attenuates or inverts the CV for that control, and the result is summed with the knob value
Shifts the phase of that wave against the other three, as much as 180 degrees either way
Shifts the phase of all four waves together, before they are mixed, as much as 180 degrees either way
Adds as much as 5V either way to that wave's own output, applied before the level and left out of the mix
Adds as much as 5V either way to the mix, applied before the mix level
Sets the level of that wave, -100% to 100%, with its LVL ASGN button choosing whether that applies to the mix, to the wave's own output, or to both
Sets the level of the mix output, -100% to 100%
Chooses where that wave's level applies: how much of the wave goes into the mix, the wave's own output, or both
Picks what the shape knob does to that wave: log/exp, J-curve, S-curve, rectify, normalized rectify, a morph through neighbouring waveforms, pulse width, and a skew or full pulse width option

inputs.text: CV for exponential frequency modulation, ignored in 0Hz carrier mode; the port menu can turn its oversampling off
CV for linear frequency modulation, AC coupled and through-zero by default, with port menu options for DC coupling and for switching through-zero off
Attenuates the exponential FM depth, 10V for full depth and -10V for full depth inverted
Attenuates the linear FM depth, 10V for full depth and -10V for full depth inverted
Pitch at a volt per octave, added to the frequency knob; in 0Hz carrier mode it moves the bias at 0.02Hz per volt
A rising edge resets the oscillator phase to 0, and starts a cycle in the one shot modes; the trigger goes high above 2V and low below 0.2V
CV for that shaping amount, summed with the shape knob after the attenuverter; 10V peak to peak covers the whole range
CV for that phase shift, summed with the phase knob after the attenuverter; driven at audio rates it gives phase modulation
CV for that offset, summed with the offset knob after the attenuverter
CV into that level through a VCA; port menu options make 5V equal 100% and make the VCA bipolar for ring modulation
A rising edge reverses the direction of the waveforms; the trigger goes high above 2V and low below 0.2V

outputs.text: That waveform alone, after its shaping, phase and offset
The four waves summed or averaged, after the mix shaping, offset and level

menu: Oversample filter quality — 10th order by default, with 8th order and a cheaper 6th order; 10th and 8th cut at 80% of Nyquist and 6th at 50%
Disable DPW anti-alias — switches the alias suppression off in all audio modes, which gives smoother results for phase distortion work in 0Hz carrier mode
Limit levels to 100% — on by default; switch it off and a level knob plus its CV is no longer clipped at 100%
LFO frequency as BPM — reads and displays the frequency knob in beats per minute rather than hertz while the module is in low frequency mode
Sync trigger threshold — High 2V, Low 0.2V by default, or High 0V, Low -2V, setting where the sync and reverse inputs count a rising edge
Audio mode default oversample — Off, x2, x4, x8, x16 or x32, the setting the OVER control takes on when the mode is changed to audio or 0Hz carrier; x4 by default
Disable oversampling, in a CV input's own port menu — leaves that one input unoversampled, which saves CPU on slow modulation
DC coupled, in the linear FM CV input's own port menu — stops that input being AC coupled, so a steady offset shifts the frequency
Disable through-zero, in the linear FM CV input's own port menu — stops the linear FM carrying the oscillator through zero into reverse
VCA unity = 5V, in a level CV input's own port menu — makes 5V rather than 10V stand for 100% at that VCA
Bipolar VCA (ring mod), in a level CV input's own port menu — passes negative control voltage and inverts the wave, which gives ring modulation
20 VPP full range (old behavior), in a shape CV input's own port menu — spreads the whole shape range over 20V peak to peak, reproducing the earlier response
